Hi Tajul — Fahad here, AI engineer in Dhaka (and a fan of the Ngital brand — the Free 30-Min Strategy Audit positioning is sharp).

I noticed your own intake is a web form + a 'reply within 1 business day' promise. That's the exact pattern I help service-business clients fix — and it's a bit ironic for a digital agency to run manual inquiry handling when you sell performance marketing to clients. There's a credibility play here too: showing clients that your own funnel is AI-powered becomes a case study you can resell.

I built an AI lead-qualification agent for your Free Audit funnel. It asks the 3 questions that actually predict fit (monthly ad budget, primary goal, current funnel), scores the lead, books qualified ones into a senior strategist's calendar with a prep brief, and auto-disqualifies tyre-kickers. Your senior strategists stop spending 30 minutes on calls that were never going to close.

I've built a working demo using Ngital's actual audit flow — happy to show you in 15 minutes. No commitment, and if you like it we can talk about you reselling the same agent to your own clients.

Best,
Fahad
